REPORT DATE: 05-30-2022 REPORT TIME: 0040 UTC REGION: ATLANTIC SUB REGION: MID ATLANTIC U.S. AREA/BLOCK: NORTH ATLANTIC 7004 IMAGE DATE: 05-29-2022 IMAGE TIME: 1535 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL2B MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 10 METER LOCATION: 40°06"02" N/69°55"03" W AREA: 0.10 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THE SLICK EXTENDED ABOUT 1.2 NM LONG BY AROUND 0.04 NM WIDE AT ITS WIDEST POINT, HAD GOOD CONTRAST WITH ITS BACKGROUND AND HAD SILVERY SHEEN CONSISTENT WITH THICKER OIL. ADDITIONALLY, THE SLICK WAS CONNECTED TO A REPEAT LEAK SOURCE. WINDS WERE OUT OF THE S AT 5 KT AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE. CONSIDERING THE ABOVE FACTORS, WE HAVE HIGH CONFIDENCE IN THIS ASSESSMENT. UNCERTAINTIES: HIGH SWELLS IN THE SCENE RENDERED THE FULL EXTENT AND DEGREE OF THICKNESS OF THE SLICK PARTIALLY INDISTINGUISHABLE. MAPS AND SHAPEFILES CAN BE ACCESSED AT: WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/

properties.summary: Incident Type: PIPELINE - NRC Report ID: 1037553 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: NEWFIELD
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1037553
Incident Time: 2013-02-04 08:00:00
Nearest City: Myton, UT
Location: SWNW SECTION 27 T8S R17E 5-27-8-17 WELL SITE
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: INJECTION WATER
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: NEWFIELD
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.091389, -110.001111 (Explicit)
Reported Spill Volume: 840 gallons
Report Description
*****WEB REPORT*** AT APPROXIMATELY 8 AM 2/4/2013 A WATER INJECTION LINE LEAK WAS DISCOVERED NEAR THE 5-27-8-17 WELL SITE. THE LINE WHICH CARRIES INJECTION WATER BROKE ON THE NORTH SIDE OF THE ROAD RELEASING APPROXIMATELY 20 BBLS OF WATER WHICH RAN SOUTH ACROSS THE ROAD AND INTO A DRAINAGE WHERE IT MADE IT'S WAY DOWN TO A STOCK POND. IT THEN FILLED THE STOCK POND AND CONTINUED TO FLOW SOUTHEAST DOWN THE DRAINAGE TO THE TERMINUS AT N 40° 5' 21.05" W 109° 59' 57.99". THE LEAK WAS ISOLATED UPON DISCOVERY. WATER SAMPLES OF THE POND AND A NEAR BY SPRING HAVE BEEN TAKEN FOR COMPARISON. UPON AGENCY APPROVAL, FRESH WATER WILL BE FLUSHED DOWN THE DRAINAGE IF NECESSARY TO BRING TDS BACK INTO NORMAL RANGES. BLM, UDOGM, & TRICOUNTY HEALTH DEPARTMENT HAVE ALL BEEN NOTIFIED. UDOGM LOOKED AT THE SITE AT APPROXIMATELY 12:00 PM.
